description: Source code implementing Vulkan tensor concatenation operations for the PyTorch library, including functions for concatenating tensors along batch, feature, width, and height dimensions, with Vulkan API integration.

methods.name: normalize_dim
methods.description: Normalizes a dimension index to be within tensor dimensions, handling negative indices.

methods.name: cat_batch
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along the batch dimension using Vulkan copy operations.

methods.name: cat_feature
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along the feature (channel) dimension using Vulkan compute shader.

methods.name: cat_feature_mult4ch
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along the feature dimension with multiple of 4 channels, optimized for Vulkan.

methods.name: cat_width
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along the width dimension using Vulkan copy operations.

methods.name: cat_height
methods.description: Concatenates tensors along the height dimension using Vulkan copy operations.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Main function to concatenate a list of tensors along a specified dimension, dispatching to specialized functions based on dimension.
